Expected output SHAPE for s10-checkpoints-shadow-git.

This chapter drives a REAL git binary against a throwaway temp workspace, so the
commit hashes differ on every run and the temp paths are random. The SHAPE
below is what to look for; the 8-char hashes are placeholders.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go run .
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
== shadow git checkpoints demo ==
workspace : /tmp/s10-demo-XXXXXX/workspace
shadow dir: /tmp/s10-demo-XXXXXX/shadow-git   (separate GIT_DIR — never the user's .git)

[init] shadow repo created with an initial commit
[turn 1] wrote app.go              -> checkpoint 91e5e0dd
[turn 2] edited app.go + util.go   -> checkpoint 3804a6af

workspace now:
  - app.go
  - util.go

[restore] resetting workspace to checkpoint 91e5e0dd (end of turn 1)
workspace after restore:
  - app.go
app.go contents: "package main\n\nfunc main() {}\n"

[safety] workspace/.git does NOT exist — the user's history was never touched
[turn 3] new edit after restore    -> checkpoint 51ba718f

shadow timeline now holds 3 commits (newest first):
  51ba718f
  91e5e0dd
  ab5e41f5

Notes:
- The two flags `--git-dir=<shadow> --work-tree=<workspace>` are what make this
  a SHADOW git: the object store lives at <shadow>, the tracked files live in
  the workspace, and the user's real repo is never created or touched.
- After "turn 2" both app.go and util.go exist on disk. After restoring the
  turn-1 checkpoint, util.go is gone and app.go is back to its turn-1 contents —
  that is the per-step undo.
- The "[safety]" line confirms there is no .git inside the workspace.
- Restore is non-destructive to the timeline: "turn 3" keeps committing after
  the restore, so the shadow ends with 3 commits (initial + turn1 + turn3; the
  turn-2 commit was rewound away by the hard reset).

If git is NOT installed you instead see:
    git is not installed; checkpoints need a real git binary.
and the tests t.Skip rather than fail.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
$ GOWORK=off go test -count=1 ./...
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ok  	learn-cline/s10	2.2s
